title: A tool loop where the client is offered a server-namespaced MCP tool alongside its built-ins

turns.prompt: Use the fixture add tool to add 17 and 25, then tell me the result.
Now use the fixture echo tool to repeat that result back to me.

notes: MCP server configuration is a driver concern, not a case knob: which servers a case's client is handed lives in the driver script (scripts/drivers/stub_mcp.py), not in a fifth knob here. The `tools` knob stays true because the client's own built-ins are still offered alongside the MCP tool; the wire_pattern claim is what distinguishes this case from a plain tool-use-multiturn one.
